CaN CTA Fall 2015 All-Hands Collaboration Meeting

Date: November 18–19, 2015
Location:

UC San Diego

San Diego Supercomputer Center

10100 Hopkins Drive
La Jolla, California 92093

Welcome

The schedule for CaN CTA Fall 2015 All-Hands Collaboration Meeting has been confirmed.   The dates will be November 18th and November 19th, 2015.   Please plan your travel to allow for two full days.   All Principal Investigators are encouraged to attend but are not required. 

Thanks to our colleagues at UC San Diego, the meeting will be conducted at the Swartz Center for Computational Neuroscience, University of California, San Diego, in La Jolla CA, USA.  An agenda will be available in late September.

A wide variety of dining choices are nearby, so meals will be on your own. However, coffee, tea and water will be provided for your convenience.
